references.text: Sanctification and purity for the Lord - to be pure (טָהוֹר) is a central theme in the Mosaic Law
God closed every womb in Abimelech's household, but opened them again - God's power over fertility
The Lord visited Sarah and she conceived - God's blessing of offspring to the innocent woman
God remembered Rachel and opened her womb - God's sovereignty over conception and fertility
Hannah was remembered by the Lord and had children - the pure and innocent woman is blessed with offspring
The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean - ritual cleansing and acquittal
Let the wickedness of the ungodly come to an end, but let the righteous stand firm - God judges between the guilty and the innocent
